facts.title: Placement and latency
facts.description: Workers placement describes where request handlers execute to reduce latency. Check the configured mode and each storage binding separately when documenting processing locations.

facts.title: Regional controls have a defined scope
facts.description: Regional Services for a configured custom domain can restrict TLS termination and Worker execution. The documentation excludes outgoing subrequests and some triggers, and says code and secrets remain globally deployed.

reviewPrompts.prompt: Which Worker, storage bindings, logs and other Cloudflare products process data for this site?
What locations and transfer arrangements apply to this deployment, including outgoing requests and excluded triggers?
Which contracting entity, processing role, retention settings and customer agreement apply?

facts.title: Processing role depends on the activity
facts.description: Stripe describes both controller and processor activities. Review the product and processing purpose before describing its role for your site.

facts.title: Account and product context matter
facts.description: Stripe says the relevant entity can depend on account location, product and context. An SDK reference alone does not identify the entity or products used.

reviewPrompts.prompt: Which payment, identity, fraud or connected-account products do you actually use, and which data reaches each?
For each activity, which Stripe entity and processing role apply under your account agreement?
Confirm actual processing locations, transfers and retention for the selected products. Do not infer these from an SDK import.

facts.title: Hosted and self-hosted deployments differ
facts.description: Supabase documents both hosted projects and deployments on your own infrastructure. A client library can connect to either, so a dependency match does not identify the hosting provider.

facts.title: The primary region is only part of the review
facts.description: Hosted projects have a primary region. Supabase distinguishes regional database data and backups from other processing, including account, support, usage and CDN activity that may occur elsewhere.

reviewPrompts.prompt: Is this hosted, self-hosted or a local development stack? Name the actual operators and products used.
Which primary project region and additional support, account, CDN or log processing locations apply?
Review backups, logs, deletion settings and the agreement for this deployment before recording retention and transfer facts.

facts.title: Sending region and storage are different
facts.description: Resend documents US storage for customer data, including message content, logs and webhook payloads. Choosing a sending region does not select a different storage region.

facts.title: Tracking is a separate setting
facts.description: Domain settings include optional open and click tracking. Confirm the settings actually used for each email flow before describing recipients and purposes.

reviewPrompts.prompt: Which transactional or marketing flows use Resend, and what recipient data and message content do they contain?
Are open tracking, click tracking or webhooks enabled? Review each purpose and any applicable permission separately.
Confirm storage, transfers, plan-specific retention and deletion of logs, payloads and backups. Review the current DPA separately; its text was not retrieved for this reference.
